tickets.title: A live child process means the worker is still working
tickets.what:
Owner, 2026-11-17: agy is misjudged when it runs a background command: herdr may show idle while
the work goes on, and the supervisor can end or close a working job. Two live runs (`tmp/tasks/agy-bg-test/`, job
`jd01d592a43b12e03` normal background, `j7715476d28018864` `IsDaemon: true`) showed the command always runs as a
descendant of the agy process (`agy → bash -c → sleep`), and disappears when it finishes; herdr showed `idle` for
5–10 s with the child alive and still `working` after the job closed.

acceptance.text: For a CLI job, a live descendant process of the recorded worker pid (`STATUS.json` `pid`, matched with `pid_start_time`) means working: the turn is not settled, no quiet-job Decision API call is made, no "write the report" prompt is typed, and the job is not closed by the watcher.
Applies to every CLI agent; it only ever delays an end, never causes one.
Read from `/proc` inside the supervisor's existing judge/tick; no new poll loop, no new process spawns.
When the last child exits, the existing rules resume within one tick.

Main-path tests with a fake CLI that spawns a long-lived child (temp HOME/HUD_HOME, no real agy): idle + report + live child → not settled; child exits → settles; quiet + live child → no Decision API call.

tickets.title: Close a settled job's worker once its report is read
tickets.what:
Owner, 2026-11-17 (option A): a finished worker no longer waits out its 10–30 minute idle window
after the main session has read the report. Reading it (`hud_read` marking `report_unread` false) closes the worker's
tab and process the way the idle deadline does today; a repair is a new job.

acceptance.text: A settled job (pi or CLI) whose report the main session has read is closed within one supervisor tick, with the same close path and STATUS outcome as an idle-deadline close (`exit_reason` says it was read).
Unread reports keep today's idle deadline. A live child process (ticket 01) still blocks the close.
`hud_send` to a job closed this way returns `not_continuable` as for any closed job.
docs/reference.md, the MCP README and `integrations/skills/hud-delegate/SKILL.md` (Repairs, step 6) say reading the report closes the worker; continuation is only for unread or still-working jobs.
Main-path tests (temp homes, fake CLI/pi): read → closed; unread → stays until deadline; read with a live child → stays.

tickets.title: Fix the worker-close review findings
tickets.what:
Review: docs/reviews/2026-11-17-worker-close-review.md (verdict: fix first). One pass, in the same worktree.

Legacy Blocked by: 01, 02 (both in wt/worker-close-02, not landed)

acceptance.text: **Only children started in the current turn count (finding 2).** Claude and Codex workers keep their MCP servers (hud-mcp, codegraph, playwright, …) as children for the whole session; they start at launch, before the first turn is sent. A live descendant counts as "still working" only if it started at or after the current turn's `sent_at` (process start tick vs `/proc/uptime`, as the pre-01 `newerChild` did), for settlement, the quiet decision and every close. Same rule for pi read-close (`hud-watch.mjs`), with the pi job's latest dispatch/send time as the turn start. A child of an earlier turn no longer holds a later turn open (accepted). Test: a fake CLI with a long-lived child started before the turn + idle + read report → closes; one started in the turn → stays.

**Automatic read-close never stops a resumed worker (finding 1).** Read-close happens only when the read report is newer than the latest admitted send/continuation (no continuation after the report), and the reap aborts instead of taking pi-role-reap's working-worker SIGTERM path if the worker is working when it gets there (check right before, or a non-forcing reap mode). Explicit `hud_close` keeps force-stop. Test: an admitted continuation, then a read → no reap; worker turns working during the reap → not killed.
**A failed read-close reap is retried (finding 3)** on the existing slow safety tick; no new loop.
`docs/reference.zh.md` mirrors the English read-close and child wording.
Main-path tests, temp homes, fake workers only; `tmp/env.sh` build + cli-judge and thin-mcp suites pass.

comments.author: legacy
comments.text:
Re-review 2026-11-17 (docs/reviews/2026-11-17-worker-close-review.md, second part): a partial reap failure
(pi quits, Herdr fails to close the tab, or STATUS stays idle_grace with the worker gone) drops the retry and
leaves the tab. Needs a Herdr outage during cleanup; follow-up if it shows up: keep the read-close cleanup pending
on the slow tick until it succeeds or the turn changes; allow cleanup when Herdr says agent missing and the pid
is gone.
